package demorobotcapacity

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// TestDemoRobotCapacity 只调用正式 loadtest；不替换登录、协议、业务或场景。
// count 是完整场景数，保持正式 CLI 的错误率 0 / p95 16s 门槛。
func TestDemoRobotCapacity(t *testing.T) {
	nats := os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_NATS_URL")
	if nats == "" {
		t.Fatal("private NATS required; use scripts/perf/demo-robot.sh")
	}
	out := os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_OUT")
	count, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_COUNT"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	args := []string{"-executor", "pool", "-duration", "0", "-scenario", "demo", "-count", strconv.Itoa(count), "-seed", "1",
		"-ramp-step", os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_STEP"), "-ramp-interval", os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_INTERVAL"),
		"-endpoint", os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_ENDPOINT"), "-server-id", "1000", "-login", "bus", "-account-nats", nats,
		"-nats-prefix", os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_PROJECT"), "-game-ops", os.Getenv("DEMO_ROBOT_OPS"),
		"-max-error-rate", "0", "-max-p95", "16", "-report", filepath.Join(out, "robot.json")}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(args, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "loadtest-args.json"), data, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	log, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(out, "robot.log"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer log.Close()
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "bin/loadtest", args...)
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = log, log
	runErr := cmd.Run()
	data, err = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(out, "robot.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("loadtest=%v, report=%v; see robot.log", runErr, err)
	}
	var report struct {
		State string `json:"state"`
		Count int    `json:"count"`
		Stats struct {
			Scheduled, Started, Success, Failure, Canceled int
			LaunchFailed                                   int `json:"launch_failed"`
			DroppedCapacity                                int `json:"dropped_capacity"`
			DroppedSchedule                                int `json:"dropped_schedule"`
		} `json:"stats"`
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &report); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("count=%d state=%s stats=%+v", report.Count, report.State, report.Stats)
	s := report.Stats
	if runErr != nil || report.State != "finished" || report.Count != count || s.Scheduled != count || s.Started != count || s.Success != count || s.Failure+s.Canceled+s.LaunchFailed+s.DroppedCapacity+s.DroppedSchedule != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("loadtest=%v; incomplete/failed whole scenarios; see robot.json and robot.log", runErr)
	}
}
